channel.title: Oil, gas & power · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Oil, gas & power in Indian markets. Today: headwind (−1.3).

item.title: [−1] Brent settles at $109.55, near a five-month high, as Iranian threats offset strong Gulf flows
item.description:
Iraq's oil exports rose above 3.4 million barrels a day in October, but Hormuz tanker traffic fell and Iran threatened wider attacks. Holding near Friday's $109.86 despite the Russia waiver. Ongoing.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Fuel retailers squeezed

Why it matters: Crude near $110 keeps India's import bill, fuel costs and inflation high and pressures the rupee and reserves.

Market gauges: Fiscal & trade balance −2, Inflation outlook −1

Confidence: high · horizon: weeks

item.title: [−1] Iran threatens to extend its maritime blockade beyond Hormuz to Bab al-Mandeb and the Suez Canal
item.description:
Another tanker exploded after a mine strike, and thousands of sailors are stranded as attacks escalate. The US says Iran has lost control of the strait. Escalating.

Oil, gas & power: mild headwind (−1) — Crude bypass at risk

Why it matters: Closing the Red Sea route as well would cut India's main path to Europe for exports and the bypass for Gulf crude, sharply lifting freight and delivery times.

Market gauges: Growth outlook −1, Fiscal & trade balance −1

Confidence: medium · horizon: weeks

item.title: [+1] US Secretary of State in Mumbai for talks today; says trade deal shaped the Russia-oil waiver
item.description:
The US asked Europe to impose secondary tariffs on India and China over Russian oil, but Europe refused. India may stress its refiners need medium sour crude from Russia and the Gulf. Ongoing.

Oil, gas & power: mild tailwind (+1) — Waiver more secure

Why it matters: A deal would lower US tariffs on Indian goods and secure the waiver on Russian crude, supporting exporters and refiners.

Market gauges: Growth outlook +1

Confidence: low · horizon: months
